functions.name: quarter_end_integer_deposits
functions.title: 季度末整数存入聚合
functions.sql: SELECT date_trunc('quarter', CAST(date AS DATE)) AS q, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(CAST(amount AS DOUBLE)) AS amt FROM obj_transaction WHERE CAST(amount AS BIGINT) % 10000 = 0 GROUP BY q ORDER BY q
functions.description: 资金维度：整万元资金按季度聚合（季度末整数现金存入候选反常）

functions.name: integer_transfer_aggregates
functions.title: 整数转账聚合（过桥结构）
functions.sql: SELECT from_raw, to_raw, SUM(CAST(amount AS DOUBLE)) AS total FROM obj_transaction WHERE CAST(amount AS BIGINT) % 10000 = 0 GROUP BY from_raw, to_raw
functions.description: 资金维度：整数转账 from→to 聚合，第三方过桥结构识别

functions.name: call_frequency_spike
functions.title: 通话频次突增检测
functions.description: 通讯维度：头部对端频次 ≥2 倍常态中位数（无对照对端时退化为绝对频次判据）

functions.name: co_located_pairs
functions.title: 轨迹同框对
functions.sql: SELECT person_1, person_2, location, date FROM lnk_co_located
functions.description: 行为维度：不同主体同地点 ±1 天内先后出现（语义链接直接消费）

functions.name: org_interest_links
functions.title: 工商登记利益关联
functions.sql: SELECT raw_name, legal_rep, relation FROM obj_org WHERE (legal_rep IS NOT NULL AND (legal_rep LIKE '%李志强%' OR legal_rep LIKE '%妻弟%')) OR (relation IS NOT NULL AND relation LIKE '%张卫国%')
functions.description: 关系维度：法人/关联人与对象人员重叠

functions.name: time_window_collision
functions.title: 中标-资金时间窗碰撞
functions.sql: SELECT l.title AS 项目, l.owner_raw AS 资金主体, CAST(l.amount AS BIGINT) AS 金额, l.offset_days AS 偏移天数, CAST(b.pub_date AS DATE) AS 中标公示日 FROM lnk_time_window l JOIN obj_bid_project b ON b.project_id = l.project_id ORDER BY l.offset_days
functions.description: 时间维度：中标公示 ±20 天整数资金碰撞（Q1，奇兵拓线）

functions.name: overpass_two_hop
functions.title: 两跳过桥路径（SQL 轨）
functions.description: 资金链路两跳：上游→过桥方→下游，与图库 Cypher 轨互为校验

functions.name: jian_cross_level
functions.title: 五间交叉等级
functions.description: 用间：语义代理表非空即命中；单源=观察/双源=线索/三源+=可立案依据候选；未建模数据源诚实标缺口

functions.name: tipoff_cross_reference
functions.title: 举报线索与已知证据交叉
functions.description: 内间：按被举报人统计举报数量，逐一标记是否命中组织利益关联/中标参与/账户持有（三类已在案证据独立支撑的自动标为高优先级）

functions.name: call_pair_coverage
functions.title: 通话对端覆盖诊断
functions.description: 生间：输出主体唯一数、对端数、中位数、是否降级、缺失对端清单——用于判断 call_frequency_spike 是否运行在不可靠的绝对阈值模式
